surface_mechanism_description: The TiO2 shells suppress recombination by passivating surface recombination sites and forming an energy barrier that prevents photoinjected electrons from approaching the nanowire surface. The radial energy barrier repels electrons from the nanowire surface, reducing the rate of recombination.
